title: Stop reaction evidence (cad-analysis stop_reaction.py, hw/checks/<V>/stop-reaction/evidence/stop-reaction.json)
description: The evidence file of the engineering.stop_reaction check: the assessment of each interface it was asked about. cad-analysis fea_reaction.py reads `ends.<limit>.reaction.design_reaction_n` and `status` from it to size an FEA load. A revolute pivot's design reaction is the applied moment over the smallest contact arm. A prismatic slide's design reaction is the axial load component over cos(theta) of the contact face, a frictionless normal-force bound; its ends record `blocks_travel` and `contact_angle_deg`, and its `loads` rows carry the direction and frame

interfaces.description: The assessment of each obligation's interface, by interface id

limits.description: What the check does not cover, as text

assessment.description: One interface: its outcome and the reason it stopped early (a non-stop, an overlap, an unknown), or the pivot, its ends and its loads

pivot.description: The id of the joint between the interface's two parts

loads.description: The use-case loads read for the interface. A slide's rows also hold each unit direction and the occurrence whose part frame states it (null for the assembly frame); a revolute pivot takes the force alone

recorded_contact_load_n.description: The recorded functional.contact.load in N, or null when none is known

unresolved_limits.description: A slide's limit with contact but no face that blocks travel, by limit, with the reason. The other limit keeps its own reaction

direction.description: The unit direction of the load, as stated in `frame`

frame.description: The occurrence id whose model frame states the direction, or null for the assembly frame

end.description: One joint limit: the pose, the contact there and, when it is a stop, the reaction

farthest_point_from_axis_mm.description: A revolute pivot's reach; null for a slide

patch.description: A revolute stop's contact patch, null for a slide or without contact

blocks_travel.description: A slide only: whether a contact face has its normal within 60 degrees of directly against travel beyond this limit

contact_angle_deg.description: A slide only: theta, the angle between the blocking face's normal and directly against travel (the largest of the blocking faces); null when no face blocks

moment_n_mm.description: The applied moment; 0 for a slide

design_reaction_n.description: The design reaction in N, the value FEA takes as a force minimum; null when unbounded

axial_component_n.description: A slide only: the load component along the slide axis, in N. The design reaction is this over cos(theta)
